companyIntro.name: Cumulus Cloud Partners
companyIntro.mission: Run customers' systems on the cloud reliably, securely and without surprise bills.
companyIntro.culture: Automate the second time you do anything. Every incident ends with a written blameless review.

projectBackground.name: Zero-Downtime Release Pipeline
projectBackground.context: Releases are frequent but 15% cause incidents and recovery is slow and manual.

manager.name: Aoife Brennan
manager.note: Speed without stability isn't speed. Show me the numbers and what we change because of them.

assignment.title: Improve release safety
assignment.brief: Compute DORA-style metrics, choose pipeline gates, handle a failed deploy and write the review.

documents.name: Pipeline Definition
documents.note: Build, unit tests, deploy to production.

tasks.title: Change Failure Rate
tasks.prompt: Last month there were 40 deployments and 6 caused incidents. What is the change failure rate?
tasks.reasoning: Change failure rate is failed changes over total changes.
tasks.mistake: Counting incidents without deployments loses context.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Mean Time to Recover
tasks.prompt: Three incidents lasted 30, 90 and 60 minutes. What is MTTR in minutes?
tasks.mistake: Using the longest incident only skews the picture.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Failed Deployment
tasks.prompt: A deploy increases errors sharply. What is the first action?
options: Roll back to the last known good version, then investigate
tasks.reasoning: Restore service first, then find the cause.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Pipeline Gates
tasks.prompt: Select gates to add to the pipeline.
tasks.reasoning: Automated quality and safe rollout reduce failures.
tasks.tip: Gate on tests, security and staging.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Configuration Drift
tasks.prompt: Production was changed by hand and now differs from code. What is the fix?
options: Manage infrastructure as code and reconcile the drift
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Blameless Review
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence blameless post-incident summary.
tasks.modelAnswer: A deployment on Tuesday introduced a configuration error that caused payment failures for 60 minutes. The pipeline lacked an integration test for the new setting and rollback required manual steps. We have added the test, automated rollback and a canary stage. No individual is at fault; the system allowed an unsafe change to reach production. We'll review the metrics in two weeks.
tasks.reasoning: A blameless review states timeline, causes in the system, actions and follow-up.
tasks.mistake: Blaming a person hides the systemic fix.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: Friday Night Deploy
caseStudy.background: A team pushed a change on Friday evening with no rollback plan. The outage ran twelve hours and cost the client €250,000 in lost sales.
caseStudy.challenges: No staged rollout or automated rollback.
questions: What release policy would you set?
How do you prevent pressure shortcuts?
caseStudy.solution: Cumulus introduced canary releases, automated rollback and a no-risky-Friday policy.

quiz.q: The case study outage lasted long because:

prompts: Which metric would you present to leadership and why?
How do you keep reviews blameless?
